_comment: Ledger of episodes the automation has already evaluated. Prevents re-sending the same episode and lets a run recover after a missed day. Newest first. Trim entries older than ~90 days.

episodes.title: 6 Questions Every Enterprise Has to Answer About AI
episodes.reason: iTunes lookup, the feed, and every podcast/show-notes host (pod.link, aidailybrief.ai, Spotify episode page, Apple Podcasts, Pocket Casts, podnews.net) returned 403 at the proxy — WebFetch is blocked broadly in this environment, not just the listed podcast hosts. WebSearch surfaced only that NLW recaps 'six questions' from a KPMG symposium (enterprise AI shifting from 'if' to 'how'), with four themes corroborated (token budgets, workforce enablement, business-model change, adaptive systems) but not the actual questions or NLW's mechanism for each. Building a ready-to-paste artifact from fragments would mean inventing content the episode may or may not actually contain. Promising — worth a manual listen once the network policy allows transcript/show-notes access.
